baseline_conflict: Tent/vestibule, partly enclosed heat and portable generator distance mixed with campfire clearance
a01_disposition: Separate 20 ft portable-generator control and exact equipment instructions from fire rules. No combustion under shelter.

baseline_conflict: Generic EPA/CDC label and wait language mixed. Device treatments implied benefit against chemical hazards
a01_disposition: Use one protocol, matched product conditions, alternative supply for chemicals and cyst-specific filter claims.

baseline_conflict: A timed window and thicker approach ice can override stable-shore witness decision
a01_disposition: Separate lay witness from immersed survivor, last route as uncertain, urgent flotation and help.

baseline_conflict: Load paths and anchors could read as verified capacities; redirect angle omitted
a01_disposition: Show static vector relationship, maintain no-load-rating boundary, exclude unknown overhead structures.

baseline_conflict: Mixing compass reference, grid and datum could move rescue point
a01_disposition: Keep all four inputs distinct; verify transformation and send raw format with known landmarks.

baseline_conflict: Fuel-powered heat limits and winter vehicle shelter are separate choices
a01_disposition: Shelter option does not qualify running equipment. Treat blocked exhaust and possible CO as emergency conditions.

baseline_conflict: Improved symptoms or fixed alternative trigger could delay emergency evaluation
a01_disposition: Rapid shelter/cooling, dispatcher directions and safe descent, with medical specialist disposition.

baseline_conflict: Cutaway or directional rule can imply universal evacuation direction or fixed setback
a01_disposition: Use verified high ground and current mapped routes; site assessment and warning take priority.
